example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গো-গর্ধভের মতো বোকা, কিছুই বোঝে না।
এই গো-গর্ধভটি ভুলটি বারবার করে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: He is as stupid as a cow-donkey and understands nothing.
This complete idiot keeps making the same mistake.
history: The idiom likely originates from rural Bengali folklore, referring to the impossibility of a cow-donkey hybrid, symbolizing innate stupidity.
note: Common in spoken Bengali to mock foolishness, drawing from agricultural life.
